name: Pabna
registryAssessment: Bangladesh's Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) and its Pabna Zonal Settlement Office are first-party cadastral custodians. The official public settlement map viewer exposes Bangladesh survey and plot/mouza lookup routes. Public anonymous parcel-vector access was verified at the service level, but exact WUP-point inclusion and citywide completeness were not verified.

queries.query: Pabna Bangladesh official cadastral map land records parcel GIS
queries.result: Found the official DLRS online land-record and survey map viewer, the official Smart Bhumi Naksha mouza/plot map project, the official Pabna Zonal Settlement Office, and a DLRS digital-survey notice covering Pabna. The viewer's current JavaScript exposes anonymous JSON/GeoJSON map routes; no safe exact-point parcel match was established.

queries.query: পাবনা বাংলাদেশ সরকারি ক্যাডাস্ট্রাল মানচিত্র জমির রেকর্ড জিআইএস
queries.result: Found the official DLRS settlement viewer, the official Smart Bhumi Naksha project describing digitized and georeferenced mouza sheets, and the official Pabna Zonal Settlement Office. The Pabna district route returned a BDS survey entry and Pabna Sadar administrative/mouza metadata; no exact-point parcel match was established.

officialSources.observation: Current viewer page exposes division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet, and dag selectors. Its JavaScript references anonymous POST endpoints and a GeoJSON sheet endpoint; owner/address data was not requested or retained.
First-party local settlement-office portal lists Pabna and Sirajganj mouza-list and survey-related services.

officialSources.role: Official Ministry of Land Smart Bhumi Naksha project
officialSources.observation: First-party project describes mouza- and plot-based national digital land zoning and digitization/georeferencing of mouza map sheets.

officialSources.role: Official DLRS digital BRS map/khatian page
officialSources.observation: First-party DLRS page links digital BRS map/khatian functions.

geometryDecision.reason: A bounded anonymous GeoJSON response was obtained from the official sheet endpoint and declared EPSG:4326, with parcel-like polygons and native Dag_No values in the response. The tested sheet's returned extent was not the WUP point [24.0069361559384, 89.2376788585173], and the viewer provides no citywide point query. No polygon was retained to avoid misattributing a sheet to Pabna city.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official DLRS settlement-map service for Bangladesh survey/mouza/plot records, with a Pabna Zonal Settlement Office as local custodian.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous service metadata and a CRS-declared GeoJSON sheet response were verified; exact Pabna city coverage, WUP-point inclusion, and citywide completeness were not verified.
